application_recommendations.recommendation: Treat fine-water-mist extinguishers, smoke detection, protective clothing, and air tanks as separate technology-transfer leads from the challenge brief; the local FLEX records do not provide evidence to recommend or design those technologies.
limitations: No effectiveness or design data for those technologies are present in the local PSI-69 FLEX files.
